title: HumanGPT — The future of artificial intelligence is Steve

beats.n01: Meet HumanGPT — the most advanced productivity intelligence ever deployed.
beats.n02: It writes your emails. It sits in your meetings.
beats.n03: It remembers every password — and only asks for vacation twice a year.
beats.n04: HumanGPT. The future of artificial intelligence is Steve.
